name: departments
title: Departments and overseas collectivities
description: The departments and the overseas collectivities.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the row, never reused. It is the target of the foreign keys of an application.

fields.name: region_id
fields.description: Identifier of the region. Empty for the overseas collectivities, which have no region.

fields.name: code
fields.description: INSEE code: two digits, 2A or 2B for Corsica, three digits overseas.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Name in lower case without accents, words separated by hyphens.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day of validity of the row (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day of validity of the row (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty while the row is valid: a row is never deleted, its validity is closed.
